0022600041.text: Sacramento hosts Portland in the Kings' 12th game of the season, and they come in at 1-10, winless at home (0-6), on a four-game losing streak, and 14th in the West. The Trail Blazers are 6-3, 8th in the West, 5-1 on the road, and have lost their last two games. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and the Kings trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, having lost all four meetings in 2025-26.
